notes:
Background: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building in-app search and recommendations. Team = PM, 2 backend eng, 1 infra, 1 data eng, 3 product engineers. Evaluating hosted API for quick integration, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.

POC summary:
- 2026-02-10: Intro call (AEs + SEs) — scope: embeddings pipeline + semantic search latency targets.
- 2026-02-12: Ran hosted embeddings on small sample (10k docs) using rdx-embedding-1 and text-embedding-3 baseline. Quality acceptable; cost estimates high for full corpus.
- 2026-02-16: Demo of Console metrics, per-route latency; client liked prefix caching idea. Asked about batching for nightly ingestion jobs.
- 2026-02-18: Onsite (virtual) tech deep-dive — SE walked through Dedicated sizing, autoscale, and VPC private link options (Jordan Kim present). Agreed to 2-week Dedicated POC.
- 2026-02-22: Initial Dedicated sizing exercise — target 200 qps read, 1k qps burst, median query latency <= 200ms at 95th pct for 90% of their search traffic. Batch embedding throughput target: 50k embeddings/hr sustained for nightly import.

Technical requirements & preferences:
- Primary vector DB for prototype: Pinecone (already used), but want ability to switch to self-hosted Milvus or Elastic later. Need clear connectors and migration path.
- Embedding models: prefer open/Redwood-verified models to avoid vendor lock; will test rdx-embedding-1 and an L2 quantized open model.
- Routing/fallback: prefer hosted for tier-1, fallback to smaller local model in outages. Need automatic fallback policies.
- Data handling: PII in ~10% of records; require KMS + audit logs + retention controls. Must support EU residency for subset of data.

Cost/Commercial notes:
- Cost sensitivity: wants to bring down embedding unit cost for nightly jobs; Optimize suggestions (batching/quantization) are high value.
- Proposed commercial path: start hosted for dev, then 2-week Dedicated POC (cost share), then commit to 12mo Dedicated minimum if POC meets latency/throughput.

Quotes / verbal cues captured:
- "If we can't bring embedding costs down by ~40% we'll have to limit features."
- "We need a plan to migrate vectors between Pinecone and our infra without re-embedding everything."

Action items open:
- SE (Jordan) to deliver Dedicated sizing doc and cost estimate by 2026-02-28.
- AE (Ethan) to send draft POC SOW and 2-week pricing/credit plan.
- Legal to review data residency clause; client will share EU data sample.
- Client to provide production query profile (histogram) and sample batch ingestion manifest.

use_case_summary: Mid-market product analytics app evaluating semantic search across product docs, release notes and support threads. Primary focus: embeddings-based vector search for in-app query routing and fuzzy semantic ranking plus nightly batch re-indexing jobs.
latency_throughput_targets: Median query latency <= 200ms (95th <= 350ms), sustained read throughput 200 qps, burst to 1k qps; batch embedding throughput 50k embeddings/hr target for nightly ETL.
integration_notes: Primary integration path: Redwood Hosted API -> Pinecone vector DB; POC will test direct Redwood storage + Redis-backed KV cache vs external DB. Client wants documented connector patterns for Pinecone, Milvus, Elastic and a migration playbook.
poc_progress: POC kickoff scheduled; test matrix includes embedding quality, latency under load, batch ingestion throughput, failover to smaller model and VPC networking validation.
risks: Data residency SLA wording, unclear long-term unit economics for embeddings at current volume, vector DB portability complexity.
additional_context: Client has active investors and a roadmap milestone tied to shipping semantic search in Q3. Decision maker = Head of Product (Marta Liao), procurement touches Procurement + Legal. They expect a straightforward SSO/SAML integration and SOC2 evidence.
notes_short: Eval hosted -> Dedicated. POC: throughput + vector DB migration. Cost sensitivity on embeddings. Legal/residency checks pending.
